proof_body:
by
  intro E _ _ _ n hn α hα
  have hb : ∀ b : ℚ, b ^ 3 ≠ 2 := by
    intro b hb
    have hx : (b : ℝ) ^ 3 = ((2 : ℤ) : ℝ) := by exact_mod_cast hb
    have hne : ¬ ∃ y : ℤ, (b : ℝ) = y := by
      rintro ⟨y, hy⟩
      rw [hy] at hx
      have hy3 : y ^ 3 = 2 := by exact_mod_cast hx
      have h7 : ∀ z : ZMod 7, z ^ 3 ≠ 2 := by decide
      exact h7 (y : ZMod 7) (by exact_mod_cast congrArg (Int.cast : ℤ → ZMod 7) hy3)
    exact (irrational_nrt_of_notint_nrt 3 2 hx hne (by norm_num)) ⟨b, rfl⟩
  have hirr : Irreducible (Polynomial.X ^ 3 - Polynomial.C (2 : ℚ)) := X_pow_sub_C_irreducible_of_prime Nat.prime_three hb
  have hmon : (Polynomial.X ^ 3 - Polynomial.C (2 : ℚ)).Monic := Polynomial.monic_X_pow_sub_C _ (by norm_num)
  have h0 : Polynomial.aeval α (Polynomial.X ^ 3 - Polynomial.C (2 : ℚ)) = 0 := by simp [hα]
  have hm := minpoly.eq_of_irreducible_of_monic hirr h0 hmon
  have hd : (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree = 3 := by
    rw [← hm]
    exact Polynomial.natDegree_X_pow_sub_C
  have hdvd : (minpoly ℚ α).natDegree ∣ 2 ^ n := by
    rw [← hn, ← IntermediateField.adjoin.finrank (IsIntegral.of_finite ℚ α)]
    exact Dvd.intro _ (Module.finrank_mul_finrank ℚ (IntermediateField.adjoin ℚ {α}) E)
  rw [hd] at hdvd
  have h32 := Nat.Prime.dvd_of_dvd_pow Nat.prime_three hdvd
  omega
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ E] (n : ℕ), Module.finrank ℚ E = 2 ^ n → ∀ α : E, α ^ 3 ≠ 2
